def transform(grid):
    """Arrange the input and its three quarter-turn rotations in a 2x2 tile."""
    n = len(grid)
    cw = [[grid[n - 1 - c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    ccw = [[grid[c][n - 1 - r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    half = [[grid[n - 1 - r][n - 1 - c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    return [list(grid[r]) + cw[r] for r in range(n)] + [ccw[r] + half[r] for r in range(n)]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import json
    import sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))
